precision.paper_measured_end_to_end_alignment: Not reported quantitatively: no acoustic-to-neural jitter or drift bound in Methods. Paper does not identify a microphone model or report a microphone-based onset alignment test.
precision.NI_nominal_sample_grid_us: 5.208 at nominal 192 kSa/s; sample interval is not onset jitter guarantee. Read back actual coerced DAQ sample rate.
precision.NI_free_running_clock: NI50ppm timing accuracy, default typical at25degreesCelsius: calculated180ms/hour versus ideal time; not a guaranteed maximum, locked SONIC drift, or drift relative to our recorder.10ns timingresolution is a separate component property.
precision.TM_source: Manufacturer brochure: PTP <1 us plus network jitter; GPS +/-20 ns RMS jitter. 10 MHz approx 2.4e-11 at 1 s refers to Allan stability plot, not hourly drift bound. Comparison lists OCXO 20 ppb. None is whole acoustic/neural alignment precision.
precision.compatibility: TM 10 MHz is 3.3 V TTL. USB-6361 supports 10 MHz reference input through PFI PLL with appropriate routing/configuration. Rice own recorder must accept suitable reference/PTP or record shared markers; recorder compatibility not yet known.
precision.acoustic: MF1 free-field1-65kHz +/-13dB raw response is from TDT2019SpeakerGuide, not a current calibrated at-ear accuracy; paper approximately80dB at ear has no quantified uncertainty.

paper_intrinsic_delay.meaning: Intrinsic delay through neural measurement, filtering and data aggregation; excludes sensory physiology and computer runtime. pxi4461_compatibility.detail: Hybrid PXI4461 retains Clk10 synchronization but lacks PXI STAR pin. PXI4461 variants do not all have the same connector.

pxie6363_specs.detail: AI/AO timing accuracy50ppm;16-bit AO. PLL can lock PXIe_CLK100100MHz, PFI10/20MHz or PXI_TRIG10/20MHz. Must configure shared clocking.

pxie1082_specs.detail: External10MHz reference output±25ppm max, appendixA. Can import external10MHz; does not prove neural clock sharing.

es1_specs.detail: Raw response4–110kHz±11dB. TDT warns signals below4kHz cause harmonic distortion and lifetime degradation. At-ear calibration required.

ed1_specs.detail: Powered via zBus; input±10V,±4V recommended; attenuation0to−27dB in3dB steps. Only drivesES1/EC1.

precision.frequency: PXI4461 listed internal±20ppm gives clock-only±0.2Hz at10kHz and±0.64Hz at32kHz. Actual tone also depends on actual sample rate/waveform. Used-board calibration and aging unverified.
precision.grid: At204800S/s:4.8828125microseconds/sample. This is not end-to-end timing accuracy.
precision.output_delay: DAC digital filter delay32/204800=156.25microseconds; speaker and air delays additional. ADC filter delay63/204800=307.617microseconds if used. Offset differs from drift.
precision.free_run_drift: Internal4461clock20ppm corresponds72ms/hour versus ideal. Accuracies valid within one year of externalcalibration; aging and current calibration of used board unknown. This is not measured recorder-relative drift.
precision.shared_reference: A correctly configured common reference suppresses independent oscillator drift; trigger skew, filter differences and synthesizer rate rounding can remain. NI synchronization guidance describes small DDS rate-rounding drift. Measure residual alignment. Neural recorder still requires compatible clock or recorded references. Chassis25ppm corresponds90ms/hour versus ideal; routing not established by slides.
precision.band: ES1 is4–110kHz;4461 AO flatness specified only to92.1kHz at204.8kS/s. Conservative comparison band4–92.1kHz; below4kHz SONIC tones missing.
precision.level: ES1 raw±11dB response is not calibrated level accuracy. PXI4461 electric gain±0.04dB conditional specification is not±0.04dB SPL. Slides omit microphone/calibrator, so at-ear±dB is unknown.
precision.neural_alignment: Slides do not specify verified acoustic-to-neural jitter/drift. Our recorder input/clock type unknown; no achieved numeric alignment claim is supported.
